jobs.title: Associate Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

ClassPass offers thousands of fitness and wellness experiences worldwide, helping people lead active, balanced lifestyles. Our platform makes discovering and enjoying activities simple, personalized, and joyful—whether it's fitness classes, self-care sessions, a healthy lunch, or a new adventure. Join us in shaping healthier, more vibrant communities around the globe.

The Role You'll Play

You'll join a team of program managers who run the operational programs that keep ClassPass partners, and internal teams moving. As an Associate Program Manager, you'll take on a set of established programs and workstreams delivered through our offshore business process outsourcing (BPO) teams, keep them running well day to day, and support the Senior Program Managers on your team by taking on the operational side of their programs so they can focus on strategy and stakeholder leadership. Your portfolio will be shaped around team needs and will evolve as the business does. This is a role for someone who likes turning messy operational work into clear, repeatable processes, is comfortable working with vendor teams across time zones, and wants to grow toward owning programs end to end.

- Coordinate day-to-day operations for BPO-delivered programs: weekly check-ins with vendor team leads, quality reviews, and capacity tracking against demand

- Manage request intake and prioritization within agreed criteria, set turnaround expectations with stakeholders, and track delivery against SLAs

- Write and maintain SOPs, job aids, and training materials so operations teams can execute consistently

- Build and maintain program reporting (weekly recaps, monthly readouts, KPI dashboards) and share results with stakeholders and leadership

- Investigate root causes behind quality misses, escalations, and rework, and drive fixes with system owners and partner teams

- Identify and deliver automation and process improvements that reduce manual effort and operating cost

- Support onboarding of partners, clients, or internal teams onto operational programs, including documentation, communication setup, and launch QA

- Support Senior Program Managers with operational duties within their programs, including data pulls, reporting, quality reviews, SOP updates, and BPO coordination

- Escalate scope, cost, vendor, and prioritization decisions to your manager with a clear recommendation

- Contribute to quarterly OKR planning and annual budget inputs for the programs you support

- All other duties as assigned

The Experience You’ll Bring

- Able to work Mountain Time hours

- 1 to 2 years of program, project, or operations management experience

- 1+ year of project and process implementation experience

- Experience coordinating with vendors or outsourced teams is a plus

- Comfortable working in Salesforce, Excel, Notion, Asana, and Slack; exposure to Tableau or Snowflake is helpful

- Strong written communication, especially writing procedures others will follow

- High level of initiative for excellence, results, and process improvement

- Strong interpersonal skills and success working in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment

- Bachelor's degree, technical certification, or equivalent work experience

- Launch and scale lifecycle campaigns from ideation through rollout using Braze and in-house tools

- Design, run, and analyze A/B tests that improve KPIs such as reactivation rate, lead-to-activation rate, and engagement

- Partner with Creative, Product, Analytics, and FP&A to align lifecycle priorities and drive high-impact growth initiatives

Experience You Bring

- 3+ years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle or CRM marketing, consulting, analytics, or a data-driven marketing role

- Hands-on experience with user acquisition or growth marketing, including lead generation, conversion, and paid or owned acquisition channels

- Experience owning lifecycle programs from strategy through execution, measurement, and optimization

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights, testing plans, and business recommendations

- Experience designing testing strategies, running A/B tests, and using results to improve campaign performance

- Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and campaigns with minimal oversight

- Strong Excel skills and working knowledge of basic SQL for self-serve data pulls

jobs.title: Junior Sales Manager / Field Sales, Fitness & Wellness, Düsseldorf (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

ClassPass offers thousands of fitness and wellness experiences worldwide, helping people lead active, balanced lifestyles. Our platform makes discovering and enjoying activities simple, personalized, and joyful—whether it's fitness classes, self-care sessions, a healthy lunch, or a new adventure. Join us in shaping healthier, more vibrant communities around the globe.

Über das Team

Das ClassPass International Team ist für das Wachstum und die Stärkung unseres Partner-Ökosystems in den globalen Märkten verantwortlich. Gemeinsam mit EGYM Wellpass, beide Teil der Playlist-Familie, nutzen wir gezielt Synergien, um unser Angebot noch stärker zu machen.

Dazu gehören sowohl die Akquise hochwertiger neuer Partner aus den Bereichen Fitness, Wellness und Erlebnisangebote als auch die Pflege und der Ausbau der Beziehungen zu bestehenden Partnern.

Durch die Kombination aus Marktexpertise, starken lokalen Beziehungen sowie strategischem Vertriebs- und Account-Management stellt das Team sicher, dass wir unseren Mitgliedern einen außergewöhnlichen Mehrwert und unseren Partnern langfristigen Erfolg bieten.

Über die Rolle

Als  Sales Manager in der Region Düsseldorf  bist du für das Wachstum unseres Partnernetzwerks in deiner Region verantwortlich. Du gewinnst neue Partner aus den Bereichen Wellness, Fitness und Gesundheit für ClassPass und baust Beziehungen zu bestehenden Partnern weiter aus.

Dadurch trägst du maßgeblich dazu bei, dass Tausende Endkund:innen echten Mehrwert durch einen gesunden Lebensstil erleben.

Lust auf echten Impact? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

Deine Aufgaben

- Du identifizierst und akquirierst eigenverantwortlich neue Partner aus den Bereichen Fitness, Wellness und Gesundheit und verantwortest deine eigene Sales Pipeline, von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

- Du baust langfristige, vertrauensbasierte Beziehungen zu deinen Partnern auf und unterstützt sie bei operativen Fragen.

- Du lebst ein Field-first-Mindset: Persönliche Vor-Ort-Termine stehen bei dir an erster Stelle, ergänzt durch gezielte Inside-Sales-Taktiken, um deine Pipeline voranzutreiben.

- Du baust dir ein starkes Netzwerk in der regionalen Fitness- und Wellness-Community auf.

- Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten strukturiert in Salesforce und überzeugst potenzielle Partner bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Das bringst du mit

- Du bringst ein bis zwei Jahre Vertriebserfahrung mit, idealerweise aus einem schnelllebigen B2B-Umfeld, und beherrschst Field- sowie Inside-Sales-Techniken sicher.

- Du kannst einen erfolgreichen Track Record vorweisen und erreichst oder übertriffst deine monatlichen Ziele regelmäßig.

- Du wohnst in Düsseldorf oder der näheren Umgebung und kennst die Region, die Menschen und die lokale Kultur. Erste Kontakte in die Fitness- und Wellnessbranche sind ein Plus.

- Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Salesforce oder Salesloft und bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Office.

- Du bist bereit, regelmäßig in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

- Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verfügst über sichere Englischkenntnisse.

Deine Benefits

- 25 Urlaubstage pro Jahr plus zusätzliche, unternehmensweite monatliche  Wellness Days  zum Auftanken, etwa ein Tag pro Monat.

- Remote-Arbeit in deiner Region mit der Option auf eine  WeWork All Access-Mitgliedschaft .

- Vergünstigter ClassPass-Tarif und kostenloser Zugang zur Meditations-App  Calm .

- Monatliche Zuschüsse:  52 € Wellness-Budget  über Benepass sowie eine  50 € Homeoffice-Pauschale .

- Professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit über  Spring Health .

- Familienplanungs- und Fruchtbarkeitsleistungen über  Carrot .

- Teilnahme an unserem Anerkennungsprogramm  Bonusly , mit dem wir besondere Leistungen gemeinsam feiern.

Kontakt

Du hast Fragen zur Rolle oder zum Bewerbungsprozess? Dann melde dich gerne direkt bei mir. Ich freue mich, von dir zu hören!

Kontaktperson: Andrew Murphy

ClassPass connects people with more than 30,000 fitness studios, gyms, salons, and spas around the world. Together, we’re making it easier for more people to discover and enjoy authentic, local wellness experiences.

The Role You’ll Play

ClassPass is looking for a highly analytical Marketing Analytics Manager to help shape our consumer acquisition and retention strategies. You’ll turn complex data into clear insights, build investment cases, and guide high-impact decisions across Marketing, Finance, and Product.

- Own the evaluation, forecasting, and reporting of key acquisition and retention metrics, including variance analysis

- Analyze performance across marketing channels and geographies to identify growth opportunities and inform investment decisions

- Build and maintain reports and dashboards that give teams a clear view of performance

- Develop business cases for new initiatives by sizing opportunities, modeling investments, and delivering clear recommendations

- Design measurement frameworks, including media mix models and incrementally tests, to evaluate marketing ROI

- Partner with Finance, Product, and Marketing to align business strategy, performance insights, and financial expectations

- Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders in a clear, actionable way

Experience You Bring

- 3+ years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, or management consulting

- Advanced Excel modeling skills, including experience building detailed financial models

- Experience using SQL to independently access and analyze data

- A track record of developing business cases and presenting investment recommendations to senior stakeholders

- Strong analytical judgment and a curiosity for uncovering the root causes behind performance trends

- The ability to make progress in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

- Familiarity with marketing and growth metrics such as CPA, LTV, and ROI is a plus

jobs.description:
At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

ClassPass offers thousands of fitness and wellness experiences worldwide, helping people lead active, balanced lifestyles. Our platform makes discovering and enjoying activities simple, personalized, and joyful—whether it's fitness classes, self-care sessions, a healthy lunch, or a new adventure. Join us in shaping healthier, more vibrant communities around the globe.

JOB FAMILY SUMMARY:

The ClassPass International team is responsible for growing and strengthening our partner ecosystem across global markets. This includes acquiring high-quality new fitness, wellness, and experiential partners, as well as nurturing and expanding relationships with existing partners. Through a combination of market expertise, strong local relationships, and strategic sales and account management, the team ensures we deliver exceptional value to our members and long-term success for our partners.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Sales team lead is responsible for leading a team of Field Account Executives to acquire high-value net new fitness, wellness or new vertical partners for the ClassPass platform within the UK. They are embedded within their market, building strong fitness-wellness industry relationships and being the first to know where the best local studios, gyms and spas are, including those newly opened, while coaching and developing their team to do the same.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

- 3+ years of experience managing a B2B sales team of 3+ reps, with a proven track record of coaching individuals and teams to consistently hit quota

- 5+ years of overall B2B sales experience, ideally combining Field and Inside sales tactics

- Proven sales record of consistent over-performance on monthly quotas and OKRs, both individually and through a team, including a demonstrated history of improving team performance, whether turning around an underperforming team or scaling a high-performing one

- Data-driven approach to sales management: comfortable moving between rep-level analytics and broader market trends to diagnose where conversion is breaking down and where opportunity exists, using pipeline data to drive coaching and strategy, not just report on it

- Data Savvy mindset: Proficiency with Salesforce, Salesloft and Microsoft Suite

- Strong territory management skills, including experience prioritising and allocating patches/accounts across a team to maximise coverage and yield in a field-sales environment

- Will be based in London, with travel across the broader region

- Strong alignment with Playlist core values and an eagerness to learn in a fast-paced environment

- Familiarity with and/or professional connections within the local fitness, wellness or other applicable industry in the UK are a plus

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Lead, coach and develop a team of Field Account Executives to grow the book of business within the UK & Ireland

- Engage directly with fitness, wellness or new vertical partners within the assigned area to grow the book of business, modeling best practices for the team

- Consistently hit or exceed monthly quotas based on new venues added to the ClassPass network, both individually and across the team

- Own the sales process end to end, defining and continuously refining how the team prospects, qualifies, and closes, through to partner onboarding, and working closely with internal teams to improve the onboarding experience for new partners

- Regularly shadow reps in the field and review activity data to identify what's working, coach on gaps, and share best practice across the team

- Lead with a field-first mindset, prioritising in-person outreach through drop-ins, meetings, and events, and selectively apply Inside Sales tactics where appropriate to accelerate pipeline momentum

- Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to improve how the team operates, testing new sales initiatives, and scaling the ones that move the needle on results

- Identify and attend networking opportunities to build strong connections within the regional fitness and wellness community

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Salesforce, ensuring reliable forecasting and pipeline visibility for the team

- Should be a good negotiator, comfortable in creating and presenting higher-level readouts/pitch decks to prospective new partners

- Partner with the UK & I Country Manager on regional sales strategy, forecasting, and team performance management

To build strong local relationships and stay closely connected to the market, this role requires the employee to reside within the London region, given their responsibility for the UK market.
